title: 第十二章
slug: 娇软妹宝随军后禁欲军官沦陷了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“当然是我女儿的！”杨文花恶狠狠的说，“你明知道她正在和小周交往，却三番两次的往她面前凑，不是破坏别人婚姻是什么？”

苏清荔望着她信誓旦旦的模样，轻笑一声，“先不说小周是单身，就说我三番两次跟他见面，那又怎样？我是跟他打情骂俏了？还是有任何逾距？都没有，那都是男未婚女未嫁，就许你女儿往别人面前凑？婶子，天下没有这样的道理。”

听到苏清荔这话，周围几个年轻的嫂子点了点头，颇为认可。

“确实，我看他俩出去都规规矩矩地，也没啥不妥，再说部队也都鼓励军人大胆追求感情，早日成家立业，出任务也没后顾之忧了不是，犯不着上纲上线的。”

“没错，你说的对。”

见众人纷纷应和，杨文花却狠狠啐道，“谁说小周是单身了？前几天我去过他家，他父母对我家春喜喜欢的不得了，还说找个时间两家人见个面，好把事情定下来。”

早在前几天，杨文花为了防止自己看上的女婿被人抢走，就四处打听到小周父母那里。

想先让闺女博得小周父母欢心，这样，媒妁之言，父母之命，就算小周心里不愿意，也只能同意。

哪知事情才刚进展到一半，就听到小周又去见苏清荔了。

杨文花坐不住，这才提起把消息放了出来。

苏清荔还真不知道这点。

即使知道，她也自问无愧于心。

小周是对她有意思，可那是他的事。

苏清荔一没有接受，二也没有给他任何希望。

小周不喜欢杨文花闺女，凭什么来质问她？

苏清荔想起在柳树沟时，也是这样。

明明是那些人非要往她面前凑，可没人说他们，只会说苏清荔主动勾引。

苏清荔本以为到了军区就会摆脱，可换个地方，还是这样。

想到这里，苏清荔看向杨文花的表情带着一丝不耐。

“婶子，我把话说清楚，我跟小周没有任何关系，你不信去问他好了，我还有事，请你们离开。”

见她直接下了逐客令，杨文花心中愈发笃定自己的猜测。

而躲在暗处看戏的张翠，见时机成熟，立刻开始撺掇杨文花

“漂亮话谁都会说，可有几个人是真做到的，除非你立字据，再有这样的情况，就离开军区。”

这话一出，杨文花眼睛一亮。

“对，立字据。”

苏清荔听到这话，目光锐利起来。

她刚还纳闷杨文花怎么知道小周来找自己了。

原来是张翠告诉她的。

Page (1/3)

"Of course it belongs to my daughter!" Yang Wenhua said fiercely, "You know that she is dating Xiao Zhou, but you keep getting in front of her again and again. What else is it if you are not destroying other people's marriages?"

Su Qingli looked at her solemn expression and chuckled, "Let's not say that Xiao Zhou is single, let's just say that I met him again and again, so what? Did I flirt with him? Or was there any overreach? None, that's because both men are unmarried and women are unmarried, so you allow your daughter to get in front of others? Auntie, there is no such reason in the world. "

Hearing Su Qingli's words, several young sisters-in-law around him nodded in agreement.

"Indeed, I see that they both behave well when they go out, and there is nothing wrong with it. Besides, the army also encourages soldiers to pursue relationships boldly, start a family and start a business as soon as possible, and have no worries when they go on missions, right? There is no need to make mistakes on the line."

"Yes, you are right."

Seeing everyone agreeing, Yang Wenhua spat fiercely, "Who said Xiao Zhou is single? I went to his house a few days ago, and his parents liked my Chunxi very much. They also said that we should meet at some time to settle the matter."

As early as a few days ago, in order to prevent the son-in-law she was interested in from being snatched away, Yang Wenhua went around to inquire about Xiao Zhou's parents.

I want my daughter to win the favor of Xiao Zhou's parents first, so that even if Xiao Zhou doesn't want to, he can only agree to the matchmaker's words and his parents' orders.

Unexpectedly, the matter was only halfway through when I heard that Xiao Zhou went to see Su Qingli again.

Yang Wenhua couldn't sit still, so she mentioned the news.

Su Qingli really didn't know this.

Even if she knew it, she still had a clear conscience.

Xiao Zhou was interested in her, but that was his business.

Su Qingli firstly didn't accept it, and secondly she didn't give him any hope.

Xiao Zhou doesn't like Yang Wenhua's daughter, why should he question her?

Su Qingli remembered the same thing when she was in Liushugou.

It was obvious that those people insisted on getting in front of her, but no one said anything about them, only that Su Qingli took the initiative to seduce her.

Su Qingli thought she would get rid of it when she arrived at the military area, but it was still the same in another place.

Thinking of this, Su Qingli looked at Yang Wenhua with a hint of impatience.

"Auntie, let me make it clear that I have nothing to do with Xiao Zhou. If you don't believe me, just ask him. I have something else to do, so please leave."

Seeing that she directly issued an order to expel guests, Yang Wenhua became more and more sure of her guess.

Zhang Cui, who was watching the show in the dark, saw that the time was right and immediately began to seduce Yang Wenhua.

"Everyone can say nice things, but there are a few people who actually do it. Unless you establish a written record, if this happens again, leave the military area."

As soon as these words came out, Yang Wenhua's eyes lit up.

"Yes, establish written evidence."

When Su Qingli heard this, her eyes became sharp.

She was just wondering how Yang Wenhua knew that Xiao Zhou was looking for her.

It turned out that Zhang Cui told her.
